idea.title: Silurus/ooxml: Pixel-faithful Office documents, rendered in the browser

plan.tagline: Automate your invoicing and collection process.
plan.problem: Freelancers and small businesses struggle with manual invoicing and chasing payments.
plan.solution: Invoice Chaser automates the creation, sending, and tracking of invoices. It sends reminders, generates reports, and helps in collecting payments efficiently.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide who need to manage their finances effectively.

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: SQLite schema for storing invoices and payments, add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Report generation for outstanding invoices and payment alerts

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with hardcoded data, --help, edge case handling

plan.demo_script: Shows creation of an invoice, sending a reminder, tracking payment status, generating reports, and receiving notifications.
